title: REQ · Lifecycle stepper and execution details show Round progress
summary: Stepper OPEN to COMPLETED with current stage, count, duration, logs, tests, release, failure
description: Context: round statuses and /api/v1/admin/executions ({id,world_id,round_id,status,error,updated_at}) exist. Desired behavior: LifecycleStepper renders OPEN, CLOSED, ANALYZING, DEVELOPING, TESTING, PUBLISHING, COMPLETED, marking earlier stages done, the current stage with aria-current='step', and later stages pending; an ExecutionPanel shows contribution count, execution duration, agent logs, test results and release version when present, and the failure reason from error. Why: admins see where the cycle is.
acceptance_criteria: Given status DEVELOPING, then DEVELOPING has aria-current step, OPEN to ANALYZING are done and TESTING onward pending
Given each of the seven statuses, then exactly that stage is current
Given an execution with error 'build failed', then 'build failed' is shown as the failure reason
Given log, test and release fields present, then they render, and absent fields render 'Not available'
Given contributions N, then 'Contributions: N' is shown
technical_constraints: Statuses PLANNING and BUILDING map to the DEVELOPING and TESTING stages respectively; FAILED shows the stage of the last known state as failed
